prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case. Based on the available listings, **Joshua P. Davis** is one strong Houston option to interview: he is board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, handles car and motor-vehicle cases, and has been selected to Super Lawyers from 2021–2026. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/joshua-p-davis/399a5d08-8f47-4358-bb07-6ff63c6a7252.html)

You could also compare **Kevin M. Camp** and **Byron Alfred**; both are listed as board-certified in personal injury trial law and handle auto-accident cases. [Camp’s profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/kevin-m-camp/ac8775e5-237a-4747-9925-132d3aef66ab.html) · [Alfred’s profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/byron-alfred/da52cf2b-cf5e-4bad-888f-d866954c4c01.html)

Before hiring, ask who will personally handle your case, how often they take cases to trial, what the fee and case costs are, and whether they’ve handled wrecks with injuries like yours. Confirm the lawyer’s current license and disciplinary history with the [State Bar of Texas](https://www.texasbar.com/). The State Bar also lists the Houston Lawyer Referral Service at **800-289-4577**.
